name: Corsican Nuthatch
rangeDescription: Montane pine forest of corsica
description: Endemic to the island of Corsica, where it is the sole nuthatch species. Small, gray above and pale below with a long bill.

name: Long-trained Nightjar
rangeDescription: Southeastern brazil and adjacent northeastern argentina (misiones)
description: Males are spectacular with a very long black forked tail with white inner edges. Otherwise rather uniformly dark-brown above with gray and buff patches.

name: Dark Batis
rangeDescription: Southern tanzania (north to the ukaguru mountains) southward to northern malawi
description: Males have the typical batis pattern of black, white, and gray. Females have a more unusual pattern, with rufous in the wing, rufous on the throat, and a variable amount of rufous on the breast.

name: Nauru Reed Warbler
rangeDescription: Nauru island (melanesia)
description: A medium-sized warm brown reed warbler with a thin straight bill and very rounded wings. Head, shoulders, and back are rufous tinted.

name: Checker-throated Stipplethroat
rangeDescription: Honduras to colombia (lower cauca valley) and western ecuador
description: This antwren is tiny, round, and short-tailed. There are no bright colors, just a mix of buffy underparts and grayer-brown upperparts.

name: Buff-throated Monal-Partridge
rangeDescription: Mountains of eastern tibet and southwestern china
description: Large terrestrial bird of alpine shrublands and meadows. Matte brown overall, with red skin around the eye, white barring on the back, rusty throat, and rusty flank striping.

name: White-backed Swallow
rangeDescription: Southern australia (except southwestern western australia and southern victoria)
description: A very distinctive black-and-white swallow of arid inland Australia. Prominent white upper back, with black belly and black strongly forked tail.

name: Common Loon
rangeDescription: Breeds in northern north america, southern greenland, and iceland; winters from southern alaska and the maritime provinces (canada) to northern mexico, and from iceland and scandinavia to the iberian peninsula
description: A large, heavy-billed loon. Common and widespread in North America; somewhat less common and more local in Europe.

name: Austral Rail
rangeDescription: Marshes of central chile and argentina to tierra del fuego
description: Scarce, very local, and rarely seen rail of Patagonia. Found in fresh marshes and lake edges with tall reeds and rushes.

name: White-winged Collared-Dove
rangeDescription: Borassus palm regions of southeastern ethiopia and southwestern somalia
description: A distinctive dove with a restricted range. The white wing patches are usually visible when perched, and become very conspicuous in flight.

name: Yellow-rumped Munia
rangeDescription: Northern australia (cambridge gulf, western australia to arnhem land)
description: Small finchlike bird with brown wings, pale bill, and yellowish rump. Found in areas with tall grass, often in flocks beside rivers or floodplains, sometimes mixed with other seed-eating species.

name: Togian Golden-Bulbul
rangeDescription: Togian islands (off sulawesi)
description: A thrush-sized songbird with a long powerful bill, an olive head and upperparts, a dark eye, and uniform yellow underparts. Juveniles duller and pale-eyed.

name: Sooty Babbler
rangeDescription: Central laos and central vietnam
description: Small dark babbler with a ring of pale exposed skin around the eye. Contrastingly pale bill stands out in the gloom of the undergrowth.

name: Campo Miner
rangeDescription: South-central brazil (minas gerais to são paulo) and adjacent northeastern bolivia
description: Small terrestrial ovenbird with a short tail. Brownish overall, paler below, with a whitish eyebrow and speckled breast.

name: Biak Whistler
rangeDescription: Biak (cenderawasih bay, off northwestern new guinea)
description: Medium-sized bird of forest on Biak Island. Warm brown above, paler below, orange-brown face and rufous flight feathers.

name: Mountain Grackle
rangeDescription: Locally in eastern andes of northeastern colombia
description: Scarce blackbird found only at higher elevations in the northern half of Colombia’s eastern Andes. It is quite slender and nearly all black, but has a maroon patch under the shoulder which is mostly hidden from view when the bird is perched.

name: Buff-sided Robin
rangeDescription: Northern australia (fitzroy river, western australia to northwestern queensland)
description: Small round songbird found in heavy vegetation along creeks and thick wet forest, including bamboo clumps, of northern-central Australia. Brown above, pale below, with broad white supercilium, dark ear coverts, peachy-rufous flanks and undertail, and white markings in wing and tail.

name: Red-billed Tyrannulet
rangeDescription: Foothills of eastern ecuador and eastern peru (southward to madre de dios)
description: Small and rather scarce flycatcher found in disturbed forest on the east slope of the Andes. Yellowish-olive with a gray head and pale throat.

name: Red-legged Kittiwake
rangeDescription: Komandorskiye, aleutian, and pribilof islands; winters north pacific
description: Crisp small gull with very limited range; breeds on rocky cliffs on islands in the Bering Sea, from Alaska to Russia; winters on open ocean. Size and plumage most similar to Black-legged Kittiwake, but back is darker gray, yellow bill is shorter, legs are shorter and bright red, and underwing is darker gray.

name: Calliope Hummingbird
rangeDescription: Mountains of british columbia to southwestern usa and northern baja california; winters to southern mexico
description: Tiny, compact hummingbird with short tail. Males are distinctive with streaked magenta throat.
